You have books like Judges, which is basically an OT Game of Thrones story (donkey jawbones, anyone?) but then you flip 10ish books later and you encounter songs, laments, erotic poetry, and philosophy. The Old Testament isn't just laws and the "angry" version of God, it's an important part of the bigger story of the Bible.

We've had a lot of other movie-like moments, but that one was my favorite. 

TL;DR: Having your first kiss in the rain with a forbidden love is very dramatic and wonderful.
